
# Density Matrix Renormalization Group (dmrg)

An educational Python package for tensor networks, matrix product states (MPS), and the two-site density matrix renormalization group algorithm.

## Topics

The package covers:

- Tensor rank and dimensions
- Tensor-network notation
- Tensor contractions
- Matrix product states (MPS)
- Bond dimension and Schmidt rank
- Entanglement in MPS
- Matrix product operators (MPO)
- Two-site DMRG
- Ground-state optimization
